title: Architecting Fairness-Aware LLM Interactions
title_zh: 架构化公平感知的 LLM 交互

paragraphs.en: 提出基于三个可复用设计模式的公平性保障架构，以多智能体框架在交付前评估并改进LLM回复的公平性。 Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly used as decision-support tools but may generate stereotypical, discriminatory, or unfair responses. As LLMs become embedded in decision-critical software systems, fairness can no longer be treated as a downstream evaluation step, but must become an architectural concern of the interaction itself. Yet current fairness approaches operate as standalone evaluation techniques, lacking a reusable mechanism to verify and mitigate violations at runtime. We propose a fairness-assurance architecture grounded in three reusable design patterns, instantiated as a multi-agent framework that evaluates and iteratively refines LLM responses before delivery. A preliminary evaluation across eight configurations involving different LLM families shows that the architecture identifies fairness violations and iteratively produces compliant responses in all configurations, with behavior differing depending on the model-family composition. These results provide initial evidence for the joint instantiation of the proposed patterns and a first step toward architecting non-functional properties into LLM-based systems.
paragraphs.zh: 提出基于三个可复用设计模式的公平性保障架构，以多智能体框架在交付前评估并迭代改进LLM回复的公平性。大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用作决策支持工具，但可能生成刻板、歧视性或不公平的回复。 随着LLM被嵌入到决策关键的软件系统中，公平性不能再被视为下游的评估步骤，而必须成为交互本身的一个架构关注点。 然而当前的公平性方法以独立的评估技术方式运作，缺乏在运行时验证和缓解违规的可复用机制。 我们提出一个基于三个可复用设计模式的公平性保障架构，并将其实例化为一个多智能体框架，在交付前评估并迭代改进LLM回复。 在涉及不同LLM系列的八种配置上的初步评估表明，该架构能够识别公平性违规，并在所有配置中迭代生成合规的回复，其行为因模型系列的组成不同而有所差异。 这些结果为所提模式的联合实例化提供了初步证据，也是将非功能属性架构化到基于LLM的系统中的第一步。
